title: 药品投诉与安全性筛查核查表
titleEn: Product Complaint and Safety Triage Checklist
regulation: EU GVP Module VI（投诉中的不良反应）；《药品管理法》（召回要求）；《药品召回管理办法》；GVP 第44-46条（严重性与四要素）
version: EU GVP Module VI；《药品管理法》与《药品召回管理办法》相关章节（条款号以现行法规为准）
description: 核查药品质量投诉处理是否把安全性问题放在首位：投诉接收渠道、不良反应筛查、与 ICSR 流程的衔接、质量调查与召回联动，以及投诉记录的完整保留。
descriptionEn: Checks that product-complaint handling puts safety first: intake channels, adverse-reaction screening, handover to the ICSR flow, quality investigation and recall linkage, and complete complaint records.

items.requirement: 建立了覆盖电话、邮件、网络与销售渠道的投诉接收途径，投诉登记完整（来源、日期、产品、批号、问题描述、投诉人）
items.requirementEn: Complaint intake covers phone, mail, web and sales channels, with complete registration (source, date, product, batch, description, complainant)
items.guidance: 核对投诉台账的必填项与渠道覆盖；常见缺陷是销售渠道投诉漏登或登记不完整。
items.guidanceEn: Check the complaint register's required fields and channel coverage; sales-force complaints are often missed or incompletely logged.
items.evidenceHint: 投诉台账、接收渠道清单、登记记录

items.requirement: 每条投诉均进行安全性筛查：是否涉及不良反应或患者伤害，筛查结论与判定人有记录
items.requirementEn: Every complaint is screened for safety: whether an adverse reaction or patient harm is involved, with the conclusion and assessor recorded
items.guidance: 抽取投诉逐条核对筛查记录；常见缺陷是只查质量原因、忽略不良反应线索。
items.guidanceEn: Sample complaints and check each has a safety-screening conclusion; ignoring adverse-reaction leads is a classic failure.
items.evidenceHint: 投诉筛查记录、判定人、涉及不良反应的标志

items.requirement: 筛查判定涉及不良反应的投诉在报告时限内转入 ICSR 流程，转交有记录且不延误报告
items.requirementEn: Complaints screened as adverse reactions enter the ICSR flow within reporting timelines, with recorded handovers that do not delay reporting
items.guidance: 追踪「投诉→ICSR」的关联记录与时限；常见缺陷是投诉滞留质量部门、个例报告被延误。
items.guidanceEn: Trace complaint-to-ICSR links and timing; complaints stuck in QA with delayed case reports are a serious finding.
items.evidenceHint: 转交记录、目标 ICSR 编号、上报时限起算证据

items.requirement: 投诉调查发现的质量风险按规定启动评估与处置，达到召回条件时按程序发起分级召回并通知相关方
items.requirementEn: Quality risks found during complaint investigation are assessed and handled; recalls are initiated by procedure and stakeholders notified when thresholds are met
items.guidance: 对照投诉调查结论与召回触发条件；常见缺陷是重大缺陷未及时升级、召回分级不当。
items.guidanceEn: Compare investigation conclusions against recall triggers; failures to escalate and mis-graded recalls are findings.
items.evidenceHint: 调查结论、召回触发评估、召回计划与通知记录

items.requirement: 投诉记录完整保留（含后续调查、处置与关闭），修改留痕，可支持检查与追溯
items.requirementEn: Complaint records - including investigation, disposition and closure - are fully retained with traceable changes, supporting inspection and traceability
items.guidance: 抽查已关闭投诉能否召回全链路记录；常见缺陷是结案后无处置记录或证据缺失。
items.guidanceEn: Sample closed complaints and verify the full chain is retrievable; closures without disposition records or evidence are a finding.
items.evidenceHint: 投诉全生命周期记录、处置决定、关闭签署
